current_focus_summary: The global-workspace/archive infrastructure is operational and the immediate task shifts from plumbing to Sprint experiments. The first post-Sprint completion target is the nearly finished legacy migration. The next strategic cluster is project-manager autonomy, learned annotation prompts, and a scoped lightweight mobile experience, while the unresolved EuroCALL AI-authorship dispute is an urgent external risk. Picture-dictionary work has encouraging initial user feedback with stronger community evidence expected after 24 August.

observations.summary: The core text and linguistic pipeline, substantial Django platform functionality, initial image generation, and cloze exercises remain delivered foundations.
Systematic end-to-end pipeline testing and UI regression tracking remain reported work, so broad stability claims still lack strong regression evidence.
Sophie has briefly reviewed the picture-dictionary workflow positively; stronger evidence from community use is expected after her 24 August visit.

The authenticated project-understanding Assistant and the revisioned global-workspace/archive infrastructure are operational, while the Sprint team wants another day of experiments before fixing measures and retention choices.

Revision 1 was preserved exactly and the live-state lifecycle now supports autonomous, archive-before-update maintenance; this revision is the first use of that mechanism in response to human evidence.
Manny reports that legacy migration is nearly complete and directs that its remaining work be finished first after the Sprint.
The first progress report was posted on ResearchGate on 23 July, completing the deliverable now represented by closed ISSUE-0008.

Both EuroCALL papers were submitted on time, but a late committee statement excluding AI authors has produced an unresolved formal dispute, with no response after more than a week and sunk registration/travel costs.
The ALTA target is undecided and also excludes AI authors, while Francis Bond has expressed interest in collaborating on MWE work.
Learned annotation prompts are beginning to produce excellent results according to human review, strengthening both the platform-quality case and a possible publication/collaboration path.
A desired first mobile outcome is lightweight content browsing plus exercises for Sophie’s Indigenous users and others before mid-September; scope and effort still require discussion.
Manny will review long-standing reported issues on 13 August, so registry staleness is acknowledged but not yet resolved.

assessments.summary: Platform maturity remains meaningful but uneven: delivered breadth is substantial, while incomplete systematic regression coverage still limits confidence in stability.
Picture-dictionary readiness is more encouraging than revision 1 assessed: initial user review is positive, but community-use confirmation remains a live checkpoint rather than a completed success.

Useful-autonomy infrastructure has crossed an important threshold from planned plumbing to an operational revision/archive loop; near-term value now depends on running and learning from Sprint experiments.

Research progress is now sharply split: the progress report is a confirmed success, but EuroCALL presents a serious unresolved authorship-governance conflict and ALTA is unattractive for the same reason.

Legacy preservation is close enough to completion that finishing it first is high-value, low-opportunity-cost work; allowing the final operational steps to linger would now be disproportionately wasteful.
Mobile access has moved from an unscoped strategic direction to a concrete user-centered target, but feasibility and the smallest acceptable slice are still uncertain.

Post-Sprint precedence is materially clearer: finish legacy migration, then advance autonomy, learned annotation prompts, and scoped mobile access. Portfolio breadth remains a capacity risk, but it is no longer an unstructured priority conflict.

Learned annotation prompts are an unusually strong cross-goal opportunity: early quality evidence is positive, they can improve the product, and expert collaboration may turn the work into publishable research.

uncertainties_and_conflicts.summary: EuroCALL may either accept the AI-inclusive author lists or reject both papers formally; the committee’s silence leaves publication, presentation, and travel consequences unresolved.
Positive initial picture-dictionary feedback is not yet evidence of successful community use; the 24 August visit is the next meaningful checkpoint.
The mid-September mobile target may be lightweight or substantial depending on current responsive behavior, content formats, exercise UX, and deployment constraints.
Sprint measures and retention rules remain deliberately open pending another day of experiments, and long-standing issue state awaits Manny’s 13 August review.
The learned-prompt results are promising but are based on early human assessment and development work; held-out evidence and a concrete Francis Bond collaboration scope are not yet established.

requested_human_decisions.question: After another day of Sprint experiments, which outcomes, human-rating measures, participant set, and artifact-retention rules should be fixed?
requested_human_decisions.reason: The infrastructure is operational, but fixing the protocol before the next evidence arrives would be premature.

requested_human_decisions.question: After the planned 13 August review, which long-standing reported issues remain genuinely open and which should be retired or rewritten?
requested_human_decisions.reason: Canonical issue freshness still limits project-wide confidence and prioritization.

requested_human_decisions.question: What is the smallest technically credible mobile browsing-and-exercises slice for mid-September, and what must be deferred?
requested_human_decisions.reason: The desired users and outcome are now clear, but implementation effort and acceptance boundaries are not.

requested_human_decisions.question: Does Francis Bond want to collaborate on evaluation, prompt learning, MWE analysis, a publication, or some combination, and which AI-authorship-compatible venue should be targeted?
requested_human_decisions.reason: The opportunity could materially improve both research quality and venue choice, but its scope is not yet known.

proposed_next_actions.summary: Use the working infrastructure for another day of Sprint experiments, then fix the smallest interpretable protocol from observed evidence.
Track and preserve the EuroCALL response/correspondence while maintaining the stated either-unchanged-or-formally-rejected authorship position.
After the immediate Sprint work, enumerate and finish the remaining legacy import/catalogue operations and record completion evidence.
Run a bounded mobile feasibility/scoping pass against representative content and exercises before committing to the mid-September slice.
Continue measured learned-prompt evaluation and clarify the Francis Bond collaboration and publication opportunity without treating development-set results as final evidence.
Record community-use evidence after Sophie’s 24 August visit and revise picture-dictionary readiness accordingly.

predictions.outcome: Another day of Sprint experiments will expose enough concrete behavior and cost evidence to narrow at least the initial outcome measures or retention protocol.

If the remaining legacy work is explicitly enumerated immediately after the Sprint, at least one of ISSUE-0010 or ISSUE-0001 will reach closure or a sharply bounded final blocker in the next workspace revision.
A bounded mobile audit will show that content browsing is feasible for the mid-September slice but that at least some exercise types or authoring functionality must be deferred.
Sophie’s 24 August visit will produce actionable confirmation or revision requests for the picture-dictionary workflow.

approval.authorization_basis: Material human-authoritative evidence supplied by Manny Rayner and recorded in canonical intentions/issues.
approval.comments: Revision 2 answers or retires four refinement requests, retains the two deferred questions, and adds focused mobile and collaboration questions. Revision 1 remains immutable in the archive.

changes_from_previous_revision.summary: Recorded human answers about publications, picture dictionaries, strategic sequence, mobile scope, Sprint timing, and issue triage; split publication work; revised all current assessments and predictions.
